XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Fuel injection

  • Component: Fuel injection control unit

  • Fault: The engine occasionally cuts out and loses power, followed by the engine fault light coming on

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system:
    • P0101 (Mass air flow sensor – Incorrect setpoint)
    • P0106 (Intake manifold pressure sensor – Incorrect reference value)
  • Cause: The injection control unit software requires updating

• Action: Perform software update of the injection control unit

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: In this case, the update was performed using diagnostic equipment.
    Using a diagnostic tool, also check that all related systems are functioning correctly. If there are any DTCs or symptomatic conditions other than those listed, resolve them before proceeding with this bulletin.
